IMPORTANT IF THIS OPTION DOES NOT APPEAR: independent Japanese firsthand report (2018) describes obtaining a third choice only after completing the other two endings and resetting. Do NOT guess at a missing option or reload a pre-reset save. Finish one of the available ending selections instead, return to the title and use 「既視感」→「記憶を失う」, then complete the remaining available ending(s). After those two endings, replay this TRUE-route choice sequence on a fresh run. The published Set-A guide proves TRUE-first on its tested patched PC state, not guaranteed on 2015 Selection; this is a source-supported recovery path, NOT a newly verified hard unlock order. Bonus 「狐の嫁入り」 (five stories) is documented after TRUE END (the primary source cautions it might require all endings).

After TRUE END, select 「本編からはじめる」 again for the no-choice CG recovery epilogue (NOT a normal new run). For 100% CGs, if you played with 「盲点」 OFF, plan a complete replay from a memory reset with 「盲点」 ON; do not assume turning it ON only for this final epilogue collects the missed bonus scenes. After all three main endings, open all five 「狐の嫁入り」 bonus stories once the title option appears. Avoid cross-run save loads.
